name: resume-applicator-links
description: Resume Applicator's redirect server: counts clicks on the links of resumes and cover letters

API_KEY.description: The key **Resume Applicator** makes under *Settings → Link tracking → Set up with Cloudflare*. Paste it as it is: the app uses it to register links and fetch their clicks.

DB.description: Keeps the tracked links and their clicks, without IP addresses. Created for you.
